exceptions.rationale: Potential denial of service through glob pattern amplification (globparts). The affected minimatch 9.0.9 is installed only through @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree, part of the lint toolchain (typescript-eslint, @typescript-eslint/parser, eslint-config-next), all dev dependencies, and never runs in the deployed application; the only patterns it receives come from the repository configuration. Only minimatch 11.0.1 and later fix it, a major version typescript-estree does not accept. Accepted by the owner on 2026-10-31 for 30 days; an agent may renew it for 30 days after a re-review while every path stays in the lint toolchain (a path into the deployed application needs the owner). Remove it as soon as typescript-eslint accepts a fixed minimatch.

exceptions.rationale: ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs. picomatch 4.0.7 and 2.3.2 are installed only through dev tools: knip, tinyglobby (knip; eslint-import-resolver-typescript under eslint-config-next), fdir's optional peer, and micromatch through fast-glob (@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree, @next/eslint-plugin-next). Every path ends in a dev dependency, none runs in the deployed application, and the only patterns they match come from the repository's configuration. The advisory covers <= 4.0.7 with no patched version. Decided by the CI lead on 2026-11-17 without the owner (no personal or customer data is reachable, AGENTS.md "Decide or ask"), because the advisory failed every plan; an agent may renew it for 14 days after a re-review while every path stays in a dev tool (a path into the deployed application needs the owner). Remove it as soon as a patched picomatch is released and the tools accept it.
